subject.title: [Bug]: v2026.6.9 regression — Codex app-server runs stamp internal turns "webchat"-bound, so heartbeat notification sends to Discord are silently denied (cross-context)

question: Which open PR should be the canonical landing vehicle for #102206: the narrow resolver fix in #102232 or the broader diagnostics/script path in #102217?
rationale: Both PRs target the same regression, but #102232 is narrower and currently proof-sufficient while #102217 expands operator diagnostics and scripts with unresolved review concerns, so automation should not choose the permanent scope alone.

options.title: Land #102232 first
options.body: Use the narrow proof-sufficient resolver fix as the release repair and split diagnostics into follow-up work if still desired.

options.title: Repair #102217 as canonical
options.body: Keep the broader PR only after fixing its review blockers, adding acceptable proof, and explicitly accepting the new diagnostics contract.

options.title: Wait for exact-head comparison
options.body: Leave all candidates open until maintainers compare the current heads and pick a single landing path.

recommendation.title: Land #102232 first
recommendation.body: Use the narrow proof-sufficient resolver fix as the release repair and split diagnostics into follow-up work if still desired.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved scope choice spans the outbound cross-context guard and the operator-visible diagnostics proposed around it.
